plan: cell-cell/工作报告/MFS0-E1.1独立研判与E1.2反馈闭环方案_2026-09-30.md §5, §7A
carrier_semantics: probability memory (plan §4: reversible route; replaces the open P1 ruling item)

policies.feedback: delta_n = o_n - p_hat_n; h_{n+1} = 0.8 h_n + 0.2 delta_n; m_n = 0.5 + min(1, |h_n|/0.2); h_0 = 0; m_n fixed before outcome n

reference_model: z_{n+1} = z_n + (1 - 0.9^{m_n}) (Y_n - z_n); p_hat_n = z_n; o_n = Y_n (ideal readout); z_0 = 0.5
seed_event_times: random.Random(20770101 + s) (d_L ~ U[0.10,0.80], recorded, unused by the ideal model)
seed_check: no 2027xxxx seed used in v4 / E1.1 code (only float digits matched)
draw_order: per stream, outcomes drawn sequentially: stable 0.2, stable 0.5, stable 0.8, reversal; identical sequences for all policies
loss: (p_hat - p_true)^2, evaluator only; controller never sees p

criteria.A1: stable, each p: |cross-stream mean of window-mean p_hat - p| <= 0.03 and t half width <= 0.03 (feedback policy)
criteria.A2: stable, each p: mean MSE(feedback) - mean MSE(fixed_1) <= 0.005
criteria.A3: reversal: mean MSE(feedback) <= 0.9 * mean MSE(fixed_1) and paired (feedback - fixed_1) 95% t upper bound < 0
criteria.A4: no fixed m in {0.5,1,1.5} with stable_loss <= feedback AND reversal_loss <= feedback, stable_loss = mean over the three p of window MSE
criteria.pass: A1 and A2 and A3 and A4 -> CANDIDATE_JUSTIFIED (go to B); else POLICY_NOT_JUSTIFIED (round ends)

alt_fixed_for_C: argmin over m in {0.5,1.5} of 0.5*stable_loss + 0.5*reversal_loss, chosen here before any device run
